name: Leading Card
summary: A prepaid virtual card solution optimized for digital advertising, featuring 3DS security and access to over 50 BINs to prevent account bans.

kyc.notes: Requirements as published by the provider; confirm during onboarding.

cons: Virtual card only — no physical card

faq.question: Does the Leading Card charge a monthly fee?
faq.answer: Yes — it charges US$5 per month. Card issuance is US$6.

faq.question: What are the foreign-exchange fees on the Leading Card?
faq.answer: There is no foreign-exchange markup on spending.
